title: League configuration
description: Everything the site needs to know about one Sleeper league that Sleeper itself does not say. Lives at league/league.json. Format details (scoring, roster slots, playoff size, keepers) are read from Sleeper and never set here.

sleeperLeagueId.description: The CURRENT season's Sleeper league ID (the number in sleeper.com/leagues/<id>). Earlier seasons are found by walking Sleeper's previous_league_id chain, so they are never listed. Update it each year when Sleeper rolls the league over.

name.description: The league's display name. May differ from the name on Sleeper.

shortName.description: A short name for tight spaces: the home-screen icon label and the PWA short_name. Defaults to name.

description.description: One sentence for search results and link previews.

siteUrl.description: The site's public address, no trailing slash. Used for links in published blog posts.

dynasty.description: True for a dynasty league (Sleeper settings.type 2). Switches the Resources page and news feeds to dynasty sources. The setup skill sets it from Sleeper.

founded.description: The year the league began. May be earlier than its first Sleeper season; see history.preSleeper.

backend.description: markdown: posts are files in league/posts/ (no account needed). contentful: posts come from a Contentful space (VITE_CONTENTFUL_SPACE and VITE_CONTENTFUL_CLIENT_ACCESS_TOKEN). none: no blog, and the Blog tab is hidden.

title.description: The blog's name, used as its page title and on the home page. Defaults to "Blog".

intro.description: One line under the title on /blog.

comments.description: Contentful backend only. Comments need a Contentful management token; read the note in src/lib/utils/leagueInfo.js before turning this on.

contentful.description: Contentful content type IDs. Contentful derives an ID from the display name in camelCase, so "Blog Post" becomes blogPost.

links.description: The league's own links, shown on /resources.

league.description: League links, shown first. A link to an internal page that is turned off (for example /blog with no blog) is dropped.

elsewhere.description: A short, hand-picked list of outside resources suited to this league's format.

elsewhereNote.description: An optional line under the outside resources.

preSleeper.description: Seasons the league played before it came to Sleeper. Each gets a page in the Seasons archive with whatever survives of it.

strict.description: Fail the data pipeline on any disagreement with Sleeper's own settled figures (a record a game off, a season's potential points a few points out) instead of warning. Turn it on once every quirk is pinned in overrides.

overrides.description: Corrections the data pipeline needs where Sleeper's own data disagrees with itself. The pipeline's self-checks say when one is needed, and each entry carries a note saying why.

statCorrections.description: A stat correction made after a week settled leaves the weekly scores and Sleeper's season totals a little apart. Each entry pins the exact difference (weekly sum minus season figure) for one manager-season, so the check stays exact.

eligibility.description: The positions Sleeper actually allowed a player in one season, where today's player data says otherwise (a TE who also played QB, a two-way player listed at defence).

pages.description: Per-page settings, keyed by page: managers, standings, free-agents, transactions, rosters, seasons, awards, records, rivalry, drafts, stat-lab, resources. The engine's defaults hold no league-specific facts; override them to give the site the league's voice.

intro.description: The one line under the page's title.

managers.description: One entry per person who has ever managed a team, active or not. Order is display order on /managers; managers with no team this season are listed separately, automatically.

url.description: A full URL, a site path such as /constitution, or {sleeper} for the league's page on Sleeper.

nav.description: Also list this link in the League menu, under Rules & Tools.

platform.description: Where it was played, e.g. ESPN or Yahoo.

importedDraftId.description: If the season's draft was imported into Sleeper, its Sleeper draft ID. Sleeper files an imported draft under the league it was imported into, so it shows up as a second draft in the first Sleeper season.

intro.description: One line under the season page's title.

card.description: The sentence on this season's card in the Seasons archive.

story.description: HTML. What is known about the season.

draftNote.description: A line under the imported draft's heading.

userId.description: The manager's Sleeper user_id (not a roster ID, which can change between seasons). https://api.sleeper.app/v1/league/<id>/users lists them.

photo.description: A file name in league/managers/ (square, no larger than 500x500), or a full URL. Avoid Sleeper avatar URLs: they change when the manager changes their avatar.

rival.description: Either another manager (userId) or a named non-manager rival with a photo.

photo.description: everyone.png and question.jpg are built in.

fantasyStart.description: The year they started playing fantasy football.

favoriteTeam.description: NFL team abbreviation, lowercase (nyj, sea, mia).

valuePosition.description: QB, RB, WR, TE, and so on.
